# BONIRA — Attendance ↔ Timesheet Reconciliation Specification

Target `PDM-011`.

`ATTENDANCE ≠ TIMESHEET`

Inputs: eligible Attendance evidence, eligible Timesheet evidence, employee/WorkRelationship, comparison period and only common governed dimensions.

The reconciliation retains source identities/versions and observed differences. No tolerance is invented. Without approved tolerance, differences are recorded for governed review rather than auto-correction.

Attendance correction uses AttendanceCorrectionRequest. Timesheet correction uses Timesheet resubmission/correction. Reconciliation does not mutate either source.

Payroll/Project Cost consume only their approved source contracts; reconciliation becomes a blocking precondition only if an explicit policy/backlog gate says so.

`READY FOR BACKLOG`
